violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: whole milk in the milk dispenser was 53ºF for an unknown period of time. The dispenser was unplugged for an unknown period of time.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The person in charge decided to discard the milk. CDI.

violations.title: Food Thermometer, Repair and Calibration
violations.observation: The food temperature measuring device was found out of calibration in the range of use. OBSERVED COOK-LINE THERMOMETER ONLY REACHING 33.4F IN AN ICE/COLD WATER BATH. EHS THERMOMETER REACHED 32F.
violations.corrective_action: Food thermometers shall be calibrated in accordance with manufacturer's specifications as necessary to ensure their accuracy. It is suggested that food thermometers be calibrated at least once a week in a cup completely filled with ice and cold water to a temperature of 32F or calibrated in a pot of boiling water at 212F. CDI: PIC CALIBRATED AND IS UTILIZING A DIFFERENT FOOD THERMOMETER ON THE COOK-LINE. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOOD THERMOMETERS ARE CALIBRATED PER THE REGULATION ABOVE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: OBSERVED HOT WATER SANITIZING DISHMACHINE IN WAREWASHING AREA MEASURING 159.1F AFTER MULTIPLE RUNS. OBSERVED HOT WATER SANITIZING DISHMACHINE AT SHAKE STATION MEASURING 158.5F AFTER MULTIPLE RUNS.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. THESE DISHMACHINES MUST BE REPAIRED IMMEDIATELY TO MEASURE AT LEAST 160F. DO NOT UTILIZE THEM FOR ANYTHING OTHER THAN WASHING AND RINSING, AND THEN UTILIZE THE THIRD VAT IN THE THREE-VAT SINK TO PROPERLY SANITIZE PER QUATERNARY AMMONIA MANUFACTURER INSTRUCTIONS.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: OBSERVED FOUR LIGHTS OUT IN THE TWO HOODS ABOVE THE COOKING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. INSTALL LIGHTBULBS TO REPLACE THE ONES THAT ARE BURNED OUT UNDER THE SHIELDING TO ENSURE PROPER LIGHTING.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED RANDALL 2-DRAWER COOLER UNDER FRYER AS NOT FUNCTIONAL.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. THIS UNIT MUST BE REPAIRED SO IT HOLDS FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW. ENSURE THIS UNIT IS REPAIRED WITHIN 10 DAYS OR LESS. PIC STATED HE HAD PUT IN A TICKET.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED AN UNAPPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK WITH A HOSE ATTACHED.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CDI: DURING INSPECTION, PIC REMOVED SPLITTER AND DIRECTLY CONNECTED HOSE. PIC STATED HE ORDERED A PRESSURE BLEED DEVICE AS DIRECTED BY EHS.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Air Gap Provided
violations.observation: Observed the pre-wash spray hose to extend below the flood rim level of the sink basin at the 3-vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by providing an air gap as specified under 5-202.13. The spray hose at the 3-vat sink shall be altered to hang above the flood level rim of the 3-vat sink in order to provide an air gap. CDI: SPRAY HOSE WAS HUNG UP SO IT DID NOT EXTEND BELOW FLOOD RIM LEVEL OF SINK. PIC ORDERED A NEW PRE-WASH SPRAY HOSE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
